environment.description: Migration script runs as a containerized job in a Kubernetes CronJob. Container runs as root with default securityContext. Migration XML files are sourced from a shared NFS volume that multiple teams can write to. The container has full filesystem access and network egress to the internet. /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), and application secrets in /run/secrets/ are all accessible from within the container.
